DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 口座を開くご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about opening an account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 新しい仕事の給与を受け取る口座が必要です。この銀行なら、どの店舗でもよいのでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 給与用口座の開設店舗に指定があるか相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need an account to receive pay from my new job. Would any branch of this bank be all right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether a particular branch is required for a salary account. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 勤務先から、店舗の指定はありますか。案内をお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has your employer specified a branch? Do you have their instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 案内には銀行名だけだと思っていましたが、小さい字で営業部名も書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 勤務先案内の営業部名に気づいたと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought the instructions only named the bank, but a business department's name is also printed in small letters.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you noticed a business department name in your employer's instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: それが勤務先の指定か、振込みを扱う部署名か、勤務先へ確認していただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Could you check with your employer whether that is their designated branch or the department handling transfers?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 人事担当へメッセージを送ります。口座番号を提出する期限は来週月曜日です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 勤務先へ照会し口座番号の提出期限を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll message the personnel officer. The deadline to submit my account number is next Monday.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check with your employer and state the account-number submission deadline. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 期限もお知らせください。こちらでは開設に必要な資料の案内をお渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please tell them the deadline too. We can give you information about the documents needed to open an account.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 資料の案内をください。今日は契約書と本人確認の物を持っていますが、店舗が決まってから申し込みます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 必要資料の案内を求め店舗確定後に申込むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please give me that information. I have my contract and identification today, but I'll apply after the branch is settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request the document guide and say you will apply once the branch is confirmed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。資料はこの一覧でご確認ください。開設の可否や時期は受付後の確認になります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Check the documents on this list. Whether and when the account can be opened will be checked after we accept your application.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一覧を受け取りました。勤務先の返事を見て、指定がなければここで相談を進めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一覧を受け取り勤務先回答に応じて相談を再開すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've received the list. I'll read my employer's reply, and if no branch is specified, continue the consultation here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Receive the list and decide to resume consultation according to your employer's answer. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お待ちしています。ご相談ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We look forward to seeing you. Thank you for consulting us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 値札で、分かりにくい所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is anything on the price tags unclear?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この梨は二百円ですか。隣の袋も同じ棚にあるので、袋全体の値段か迷いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 同じ棚のばら梨と袋の値札の対応を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Is this pear 200 yen? The bag beside it is on the same shelf, so I wasn't sure if that price was for the whole bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how the tags correspond to loose pears and bags on the same shelf. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二百円はばら売り一個の値段です。三個入りの袋は、袋の表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: 200 yen is the price for one loose pear. Please check the label on the bag of three.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 袋には五百四十円とありますね。ばらで三個なら六百円なので、袋の方が安いですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三個の合計価格を比べ袋売りが安いか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: The bag says 540 yen. Three loose ones would be 600 yen, so is the bag cheaper?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Compare the total for three and ask whether the bag is cheaper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その表示ではそうなります。ただ、袋の梨は少し小さめです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: According to those labels, yes. However, the pears in the bag are a little smaller.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今日は二人で一個を分けたいので、大きいばらの物を一個選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 用途を理由に大きいばら梨を一個選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Today two of us will share one pear, so I'll choose one large loose pear.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose one large loose pear and explain its intended use. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: どうぞ。重さで量る品ではなく、一個ずつお会計します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Go ahead. These aren't weighed; each pear is charged individually.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一個ですね。袋から取り出して買うのではなく、このばらの棚から選べばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: ばら品を選ぶ棚と袋を開けないことを確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: One pear, right. Should I choose from this loose shelf rather than take one out of a bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm which shelf to choose from and that you should not open a bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。三個入りの袋は開けず、こちらの棚からお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Don't open the bags of three; please choose from this shelf.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この大きい梨を選びました。袋の方と混ざらないよう、レジで一個と伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一個を選びレジで数量を伝えると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've chosen this large pear. I'll say it's one pear at checkout so it isn't confused with the bagged ones.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Select one pear and say you will state the quantity at checkout. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。おいしく召し上がれますように。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you. I hope you enjoy it. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 園内図で道をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you finding your way on the park map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 池まで少し歩きたいです。図では右なのに、目の前には左へ曲がる道しか見えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 地図の左右と見える道が合わないと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like a short walk to the pond. The map shows right, but I can only see a path turning left in front of me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that the map's left and right do not match the visible path. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 図の上が北です。今は南向きに立っているので、左右が逆に見えますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: The top of the map is north. You're facing south, so left and right appear reversed.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 自分の向きと図の向きが違うのですね。図を回して、今見ている景色と合わせてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 地図と自分の向きの違いを理解し地図を回せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: My direction differs from the map's, then. May I turn the map to match the scenery I'm seeing?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Understand the difference in direction and ask to rotate the map. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。入口の印を手前にすると、目の前の道と合います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Put the entrance symbol nearest you and it matches the path ahead.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 回したら左の道が池へ続いていました。図にある丸い建物は、あの売店ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 図を回して道を読み建物の印を実物と照合する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: After turning it, the left path led to the pond. Is the round building on the map that shop?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Rotate the map, read the path, and match a building symbol to the actual building. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: そうです。売店は左の道の途中です。池はその先にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's right. The shop is along the left path, with the pond beyond it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 売店を通り過ぎればよいですね。帰りは図を元に戻さず、自分の向きに合わせ直せばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 往路の目印を確認し帰りの地図の向きを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I should pass the shop, then. On the way back, should I align the map with my direction again rather than return it to its original position?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm the outward landmark and ask about orienting the map on return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 戻る時は向きが変わるので、入口と売店の位置を景色と合わせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Your direction changes on return, so match the entrance and shop positions to the scenery.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 二つの建物を目印にします。池まで歩いて、帰りにも向きを合わせて入口へ戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 建物で地図と景色を照らし池まで往復すると決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll use those two buildings as landmarks. I'll walk to the pond and align the map again on the way back to the entrance.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Use the buildings to match map and scenery and decide on the pond round trip. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくり。お散歩をお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28208-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take your time. Enjoy your walk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 工事中の通路についてご案内します。どちらへ行かれますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll explain the passage under construction. Where are you going?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 南線へ乗り換えます。いつも使う階段が囲われていますが、今日は通れませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 通常の乗換階段が使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm transferring to the South Line. My usual stairs are fenced off; can't I use them today?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether your usual transfer stairs can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今日は使えません。奥の仮通路から、別の階段へ回ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Not today. Take the temporary passage at the back to the other stairs.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 奥の仮通路ですね。いつもより何分くらい余計に見ておけばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 仮通路の余分な移動時間を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: The temporary passage at the back, right. How many extra minutes should I allow?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask how much extra travel time the temporary passage requires. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩いて三分ほど増えます。乗り換える列車は、何時ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: About three more minutes on foot. What time is your connecting train?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 九時二十分です。今からだと急いで階段を使うことになりそうです。次の列車もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 予定列車では急ぐことになると説明し次便を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: 9:20. Starting now, it looks like I'd have to hurry on the stairs. Is there another train afterward?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that your planned train would require rushing and ask about the next one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次は九時三十五分です。仮通路は幅が狭いので、走らずお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next is 9:35. The temporary passage is narrow, so please walk without running.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 三十五分の列車にします。仮通路の出口で、南線のどちらのホームへ出ますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 次便へ変更し仮通路出口のホーム案内を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll take the 9:35. Which South Line platform does the temporary passage exit lead to?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Change to the next train and ask for platform directions at the passage exit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 両方向への案内がある広場へ出ます。南町方面は二番ホームの表示です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: It leads to an open area with signs for both directions. For Minamimachi, follow Platform 2.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 広場で二番ホームを探します。次の列車にしたので、急がず回れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 広場で目的方面のホームを探して移動すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look for Platform 2 in the open area. Choosing the next train means I can go around without rushing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will find your direction's platform in the open area and proceed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。お気をつけて行ってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 証明書の申請でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you applying for a certificate?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 二か所へ出すので二通欲しいのですが、一方は「写し可」とあります。二通取らなくてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 原本と写しで二通の発行が必要か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I want two for two destinations, but one says a copy is acceptable. Do I really need two issued?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether two certificates must be issued when an original and a copy may suffice. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 提出先の指定が「写し可」なら、何を写すのかも案内で確認しましょう。お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the destination accepts a copy, let's check what must be copied in their instructions. Do you have them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: こちらです。原本一通を先の学校へ出して、もう一方にはそのコピーを出せると書いてあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先案内の原本一通とコピーの指定を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. It says to submit one original to the first school, and a photocopy of it to the other destination.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the instructions requiring one original and one photocopy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 案内では、そのように読めます。コピーは原本を提出する前に用意できますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: That is how the instructions read. You can make the copy before submitting the original.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 先にコピーを取ります。今日は原本を一通だけ申請したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 原本を提出前にコピーし一通だけ申請する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll copy it first. Today I'd like to apply for just one original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Plan to copy before submission and apply for one original only. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 一通で承ります。コピーに追加の記入が必要かは、もう一方の提出先へお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll accept an application for one. Please check with the other destination whether anything must be added to the copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: その案内には、自分の受付番号を余白に書くとあります。原本には書かず、コピーへ書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 原本とコピーへの追加記入の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Its instructions say to write my reception number in the margin. I'll write it on the copy, not the original.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the different additional writing on the original and copy. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二つの扱いを分けられましたね。こちらへ必要な証明書の種類をお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: You've distinguished the two uses. Write the type of certificate you need here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 種類と一通と書きました。原本を受け取ったら、学校へ出す前にコピーします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 申請通数を記入し提出前のコピー予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I've written the type and one copy. After receiving the original, I'll photocopy it before submitting it to the school.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Fill in the number requested and explain copying before submission. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 申請書をお預かりします。窓口へどうぞ。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll take your application. Please go to the counter. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票の睡眠の欄で、お尋ねがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question about the sleep section of the medical questionnaire?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 夜勤があります。「寝る時刻」は、夜勤明けに寝る昼の時刻を書いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 夜勤明けに昼に寝る時刻を問診へ書けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I work night shifts. For bedtime, may I write the daytime hour when I sleep after a night shift?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether to enter daytime sleep after a night shift on the questionnaire. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい。勤務の日と休みの日で違うことも、お知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes. Also tell us that it differs between workdays and days off.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 夜勤明けは朝九時に寝ます。休みの日は夜十一時なので、一つの時刻だけでは合いません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 夜勤明けと休日の就寝時刻を分けて説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: After a night shift I sleep at nine in the morning. On days off it's eleven at night, so a single time doesn't fit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain separate bedtimes after night shifts and on days off. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二つの時刻を分けて書けます。起きる時刻も、それぞれ伺います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: You can write the two times separately. We'll ask each waking time too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夜勤明けは午後三時、休みの日は朝七時です。夜勤の前には一時間ほど仮眠も取ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: それぞれの起床時刻と勤務前の仮眠を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: After a night shift it's three in the afternoon; on days off, seven in the morning. I also nap about an hour before a night shift.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the two waking times and the nap before work. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仮眠のことも、余白へお書きください。眠りについて、今困っていることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Write the nap in the margin too. Are you having any sleep problems now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 休みの日も明け方に目が覚めます。でも、夜勤明けの昼は続けて眠れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 休日の早い目覚めと昼の睡眠の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Even on days off I wake around dawn. But during the day after a night shift I can sleep continuously.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain early waking on days off versus continuous daytime sleep. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 仕事のない日の目覚めの様子を、診察でもお話しください。夜勤は週に何回でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Tell the doctor about waking on days without work too. How many night shifts a week?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 週二回です。二つの睡眠時間と仮眠を書き、休日の明け方に目が覚めることを先生へ話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 夜勤の頻度と睡眠と仮眠を記入し困る点を診察で話すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Twice a week. I'll write the two sleep schedules and the nap, then tell the doctor I wake around dawn on days off.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: State night-shift frequency, record sleep and naps, and say you will discuss the problem at consultation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 問診票を確認しました。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've checked your questionnaire. Please take care of yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 訪問した人についてのご相談ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here about someone who visited you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家に来た人が警察だと言って、口座の確認を求めました。制服ではなく、名前も聞き取れませんでした。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 警察を名乗る訪問者の口座確認要求を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Someone came to my home claiming to be police and asked to check my account. They weren't in uniform, and I couldn't catch the name.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss a visitor claiming to be police and requesting an account check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何時ごろでしたか。相手は今も家にいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Around what time? Are they still at your home?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一時間前で、もう帰りました。夕方また来ると言われ、名刺だけ置いていきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 訪問時刻と退去済みと再訪予告を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: An hour ago, and they've left. They said they'd return this evening and left only a business card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the visit time, confirm departure, and mention the promised return. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 名刺を拝見します。口座について、何か渡したり見せたりしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let me see the card. Did you hand over or show anything concerning your account?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 何も見せていません。家の中にも入っていません。名刺にある番号にも電話していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 情報や入室の許可をしていないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: I showed nothing. They didn't enter the home either. I haven't called the number on the card.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you provided no information or permission to enter. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらで訪問の事実を確認します。夕方に来ても、確認が済むまでドアを開けて対応しないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: We'll verify the visit. Even if they come this evening, don't open the door to deal with them until verification is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 確認をお願いします。玄関の録画には顔と時刻が残っています。映像も見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 訪問確認を頼み録画の確認を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please verify it. The entrance recording shows their face and the time. Can you look at the footage too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Request verification of the visit and the recording. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 残っている映像の扱いをご案内します。今お持ちの端末で確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain how to handle the existing footage. Can you view it on the device you have now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: この携帯で見られます。名刺と映像をお見せして、再訪の前に相談を進めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 名刺と録画を示し再訪前に相談したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I can see it on this phone. I'd like to show the card and footage and proceed with consultation before they return.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Show the business card and footage and request consultation before the next visit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの相談席で伺います。お知らせありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll listen at this consultation desk. Thank you for notifying us. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 荷物の送り先は、こちらの宿泊施設ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: This accommodation is the destination for your parcel, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。週末に泊まる宿へ送ります。送り状は宿の名前だけ書けばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿泊先への送り状の宛名を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'm sending it to where I'll stay this weekend. Is just the accommodation's name enough on the label?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to address a shipping label to your accommodation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宿が指定する宛名があれば、それに合わせてください。荷物の受け取りについて、宿へ連絡しましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: If the accommodation specifies an addressee, follow that. Have you contacted them about receiving it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 受け取れると返事をもらいました。宿泊する人の名前と到着予定日を書くよう言われています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 宿への受取確認と氏名と到着日の指定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: They replied that they can receive it. They told me to write the guest's name and expected arrival date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Report confirmed acceptance and the required name and arrival date. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その二つが宿での確認に役立ちます。到着予定日はどちらへ書きましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Those two details help them identify it. Where will you write the arrival date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 宛名の横の余白に、土曜日の日付と自分の名前を書きます。宿の住所はこのメールにあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 宛名へ追記する日付と氏名と住所資料を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: In the margin beside the addressee, I'll write Saturday's date and my name. Their address is in this email.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the added date and name and the source of the address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: メールの住所と送り状を照らし合わせてください。配達希望日はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Compare the email address with the label. Is there a preferred delivery date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 宿から前日の金曜日を指定されました。間に合わない場合は、自分で持っていきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 宿指定の配達希望日と未達の場合の持参代案を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: The accommodation specified Friday, the day before. If it won't arrive in time, I'd like to carry it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the accommodation's delivery date and the fallback of carrying it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この住所へのお届け予定を受付で確認します。希望日を保証する前に、発送条件をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The desk will check the expected delivery for this address. We'll explain shipping conditions before guaranteeing your preferred date.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。宛名は書けましたが、予定を聞いてから発送するか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名を用意し配送予定を聞いて発送判断すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. I've written the addressee, but I'll decide whether to send it after hearing the schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Prepare the addressee and say you will decide after hearing the delivery schedule. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、荷物と送り状を受付へどうぞ。ご準備ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take the parcel and label to reception. Thank you for preparing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お振込みの準備で、お尋ねがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have a question while preparing a transfer?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家賃を振り込みます。五万円と書いたのですが、通知には管理費三千円も載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家賃額に別記の管理費が必要か相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'm transferring rent. I wrote 50,000 yen, but the notice also lists a 3,000-yen management fee.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the separately listed management fee must be added to rent. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 管理費も同じ振込みに含める指定でしょうか。通知を拝見します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Does it specify including the management fee in the same transfer? Let me see the notice.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 下に「合計五万三千円」とありました。去年の家賃だけを覚えていて、少なく書いてしまいました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 通知の合計と誤記した金額の違いを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: At the bottom it says total 53,000 yen. I only remembered last year's rent and wrote too little.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the difference between the notice total and your mistaken amount. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 振込額は今回の通知を基にご確認ください。まだ受付はしていませんので、依頼書を直せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Check the transfer amount against this notice. We haven't accepted it yet, so you can correct the request form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 五万三千円に直します。数字の途中を直すより、新しい用紙に書き直した方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 正しい合計に直す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll change it to 53,000 yen. Is it better to use a new form rather than alter part of the number?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask how to correct it to the proper total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 書き直す用紙はこちらです。古い用紙もこちらへお渡しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Here's a new form. Please give us the old one too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い方を渡して、新しい方へ全額を書きました。今月から管理費が増えたことも通知にありました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 旧用紙を渡し新用紙に全額を書き管理費変更を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I've handed over the old form and written the full amount on the new one. The notice also said the management fee increased this month.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Hand over the old form, enter the full amount on the new one, and report the management-fee change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 振込先と金額を、新しい依頼書で見直してください。自動の振込み設定は使っていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check the destination and amount on the new request. Are you using an automatic transfer setting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 設定は使っていません。来月も古い金額を写さず通知を見ます。今日は五万三千円をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自動設定がないと答え今回の合計で振込みを依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: No, I'm not. Next month I'll read the notice rather than copy the old amount. Please transfer 53,000 yen today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you have no automatic setting and request the current total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 新しい依頼書で承ります。ご確認ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll process the new request. Thank you for checking. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらでお会計します。袋はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll ring this up here. Do you have a bag?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 小さい袋を一つ持っています。水を二本入れると、卵が入らなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 持参袋が小さく水と卵が収まるか心配と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have one small bag. With two water bottles, there may be no room for the eggs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say your bag is small and you worry about fitting water and eggs. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 袋を追加でお買い求めいただけます。別々に入れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: You can buy an extra bag. Would you like them separated?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日は歩いて帰るので、荷物を減らします。水を一本だけにしてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 歩いて帰るため水を一本に減らしたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'm walking home today, so I'll reduce the load. Could I take just one bottle of water?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to reduce the water to one bottle because you are walking home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ会計前ですので、一本をこちらでお戻しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: You haven't paid yet, so we'll put one back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。水は袋の底へ、卵は上へ置きたいです。袋に収まりそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 商品を入れる順序と袋への収まりを尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I'd like the water at the bottom and eggs on top. Will they fit in the bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about packing order and whether they will fit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの台で大きさを見られます。卵の箱を横へ立てずに入るかお試しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can check the size on this table. Try fitting the egg carton flat rather than standing it on its side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 平らに置いて収まりました。追加の袋は要りません。この袋へ詰めるのは会計後ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 卵を平らに置けたと伝え袋不要と詰める時期を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: It fitted flat. I don't need another bag. I pack this bag after payment, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say the eggs fit flat, decline an extra bag, and confirm when to pack. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。今は商品をかごに戻して、お会計をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Return the goods to the basket now and pay, please.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 水一本と卵一箱でお願いします。会計後に底と上を分けて入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計数量と袋への入れ方を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: One bottle and one carton of eggs, please. After payment I'll put them separately at the bottom and top.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give checkout quantities and explain packing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。お買物ありがとうございました。お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-28210-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly. Thank you for shopping. Take care.
